verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents its own SDKs: a Swift SDK, a Kotlin SDK, and a React Native SDK, which gives a JavaScript route. It also cites "one C++ core, six thin bindings." The OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint relies on OpenAI's official clients, not RunAnywhere's own libraries, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official Python library, a general-purpose JavaScript/Node or web library beyond React Native, a named list of the six bindings, and independent corroboration of SDK use.
